Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with immediate
complaints of neck pain and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the crash, and the
presenting symptoms align well with a cervical strain. Cervical imaging and physical
examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient reports no
prior injury or treatment to the neck or upper back. Over the course of care, the
patient completed 28 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this
type of injury, with gradual imporvement in range of motion and pain levels. Billing
records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or
repeated billing entries. Current status shows partial resolution of symptoms, and the
provider recommends continued home exercise and periodic reassessment as needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
